tools.name: vibex_list_projects
tools.title: List my VibeX projects
tools.description: List only projects owned by the signed-in VibeX user.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_project
tools.title: Get VibeX project
tools.description: Get safe metadata and current stable revision for one owned project.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_create_project
tools.title: Create VibeX project
tools.description: Create one minimal web project after the user explicitly requests it; never publish automatically.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_list_capabilities
tools.title: List VibeX capabilities
tools.description: List the canonical CC capability catalog, including built-in and selectable capabilities.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_project_capabilities
tools.title: Get project capabilities
tools.description: Read one owned project's versioned capability configuration and apply status.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_prepare_capability_change
tools.title: Prepare capability change
tools.description: Prepare a single-use capability change summary. This does not modify source or the published snapshot.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_set_project_capabilities
tools.title: Set project capabilities
tools.description: Apply one prepared capability change only after the user explicitly confirms its exact digest.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_diagnostics
tools.title: Diagnose a VibeX project
tools.description: Read a bounded, redacted health summary for one owned project. Internal hosts, paths, logs, and credentials are never returned.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_list_revisions
tools.title: List VibeX source revisions
tools.description: List bounded immutable source history and indicate which revisions can be safely rolled back.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_compare_revisions
tools.title: Compare VibeX source revisions
tools.description: Compare immutable manifests without exposing file contents. Returns bounded added, removed, and changed paths.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_prepare_rollback
tools.title: Prepare VibeX rollback confirmation
tools.description: Prepare a single-use rollback summary bound to the exact current and target source revisions. This does not change source.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_rollback_project
tools.title: Rollback a VibeX project after confirmation
tools.description: Consume one prepared rollback intent only after explicit confirmation. Verifies the restored canonical source before reporting success.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_cover
tools.title: Get VibeX project cover
tools.description: Read the saved CDN cover URL and the bounded status of any cover-generation job for one owned project. Generated covers are stored on the project CDN when generation succeeds.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_prepare_cover_generation
tools.title: Prepare VibeX cover generation
tools.description: Prepare a single-use confirmation card for generating one cover from the exact title and summary. This does not start generation.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_generate_cover
tools.title: Generate a VibeX cover after confirmation
tools.description: Consume one prepared cover intent after explicit confirmation and start exactly one generation job. This never publishes the project.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_upload_cover
tools.title: Upload a VibeX project cover
tools.description: Center-crop one owner-bound PNG, JPEG, or WebP image to 16:9, convert it to 1200x675 WebP, store it on the project CDN as the saved cover, and return the public HTTPS URL. This replaces the saved cover, does not stretch the image, and never publishes the project.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_project_metrics
tools.title: Get VibeX project metrics
tools.description: Read privacy-safe aggregate page views, visitors, and task outcomes for a bounded 1-90 day window. No visitor or task identifiers are returned.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_source_tree
tools.title: Get VibeX source tree
tools.description: Read a paginated source tree pinned to an immutable source revision.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_read_source_file
tools.title: Read VibeX source file
tools.description: Read a bounded range of an allowed file from an immutable source revision.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_initialize_source
tools.title: Initialize VibeX source revision
tools.description: Create the initial immutable source revision for an owned running legacy Web project only when project metadata advertises source_initialize and the user already requested an edit. Repeated calls are idempotent. This never edits source or publishes.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_begin_edit
tools.title: Begin confirmed VibeX edit
tools.description: Acquire an isolated edit intent, lease, and fencing token for the displayed bounded plan.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_renew_edit
tools.title: Renew VibeX edit lease
tools.description: Renew an active edit lease without changing source.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_apply_patch
tools.title: Apply confirmed VibeX patch
tools.description: Apply one standard unified diff (---/+++/@@ headers) to the isolated staging workspace. Include all approved changed files in one call; Codex apply_patch wrapper markers are not accepted.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_commit_edit
tools.title: Commit confirmed VibeX edit
tools.description: Validate and promote staged changes to a new stable revision; never publish them.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_cancel_edit
tools.title: Cancel VibeX edit
tools.description: Cancel an edit session and discard only its uncommitted staging changes.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_upload_project_image
tools.title: Upload a VibeX project image
tools.description: Convert one owner-bound PNG, JPEG, or WebP image to WebP, store it on the project CDN, and return a public HTTPS URL. This does not edit source, change the cover, or publish.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_upload_project_video
tools.title: Upload a VibeX project video
tools.description: Transcode one owner-bound MP4, MOV, or WebM clip to a compact H.264 MP4, store it on the project CDN, and return a public HTTPS URL. Clips are capped at 20 seconds and 8MB before compression. This does not edit source, change the cover, or publish.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_prepare_preview
tools.title: Prepare VibeX preview
tools.description: Create a short-lived single-use launch URL pinned to one immutable revision. This does not edit or publish the project.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_pricing
tools.title: Get VibeX creator pricing
tools.description: Read the current creator markup, protocol eligibility, active-release effect, republish requirement, and RH synchronization state for an exact source revision.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_prepare_pricing
tools.title: Prepare VibeX creator-pricing confirmation
tools.description: Prepare a single-use financial-effect summary for one markup percentage. This does not change visitor pricing.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_set_pricing
tools.title: Apply explicitly confirmed VibeX creator pricing
tools.description: Consume one prepared pricing intent only after the user explicitly confirms the exact financial-effect summary. Never publish automatically.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_publish_form
tools.title: Get VibeX publish form
tools.description: Read the current cover, title, summary, defaults, and allowed publish options. Show these values and collect explicit choices before preparing a publish.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_publish_readiness
tools.title: Check VibeX publish readiness
tools.description: Check source and publish-service availability before asking for confirmation. A blocked or unavailable result must be shown to the user and publishing must stop.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_prepare_publish
tools.title: Prepare VibeX publish confirmation
tools.description: Prepare a single-use summary and digest. This does not publish.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_publish_project
tools.title: Publish explicitly confirmed VibeX project
tools.description: Consume one prepared publish intent only after the user explicitly confirms the exact summary. Never call automatically after editing or preview.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse

tools.name: vibex_get_operation_status
tools.title: Get VibeX operation status
tools.description: Read safe status for an existing owned operation without retrying or repeating it.

outputSchema.description: Stable response envelope shared by every public tool.
outputSchema.title: PublicResponse
